title: Machine Learning for Synthetic Data Generation: A Review

bias_targets.methodology: The paper reviews fairness-aware synthetic data generation methods designed to mitigate disparate impact, under-representation of minority groups, and subgroup imbalances via pre-processing, in-processing, and post-processing techniques.

The paper discusses challenges in AI-Generated Content (AIGC) and foundation models where generated text and images may inherit and amplify stereotypes, exclusion, and marginalization found in real-world training data.
